{{Otheruses|Antilles}}
The '''Antilles Map''' was a map that was discovered in the [[Great Duinarbulon Mausoleum]] by the historian [[Henrietya Antilles]] during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It showed that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wyndigal 2]] was once called Huronom and that the planet [[OHS3842-03]] was once known as Astigone.<ref name="TEA">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>
